text.en: This weapon does more damage to enemies based on the number of SIVA nanites that attach to them.
This weapon does more damage to enemies based on the number of SIVA nanites that attach to them.

Deal increased damage to targets with SIVA Nanites attached to them.

Damage at 1|2|3|4|5 Nanites:
• PvE: 30%|60%|90%|120%|150%
• PvP: 15%|30%|45%|60%|75%

For each additional Nanite beyond five, the target takes 2.1% additional damage, up to a maximum of 350% increased damage at 100 Nanites.
